$comment: RP-2901 sucker-rod pumping system twin. Expected loads, torque and production in Maximo Monitor from the pumping unit rating, the rod string and the well data; the rod pump controller sends only what it measures and the features of its pump card.

identification.description: Rod-lifted oil well: beam pumping unit, tapered steel rod string, insert pump at 6,000 ft, rod pump controller
identification.unit: Conventional crank-balanced beam pumping unit, API Spec 11E size C-320D-256-120
identification.rods: API Spec 11B grade D steel sucker rods, 7/8 in over 3/4 in taper
identification.pump: API Spec 11AX insert (rod) pump, 1.50 in bore, in 2-7/8 in anchored tubing
identification.controller: Rod pump controller (RPC) with polished-rod load cell and position sensor; computes the downhole pump card (wave equation) every stroke and stops the unit at pump-off

unit.source: Lufkin pumping unit catalog 2007: designation C-320D-256-120 (gear reducer 320,000 in-lb, structure 25,600 lb, maximum stroke 120 in) and 320D gear ratio 30.12:1. Stroke set on the longest crank hole and 8.5 strokes per minute; counterbalance effect (CBE) at the polished rod from the last balance survey: assumption: typical value, replace with your well file / last dynamometer survey

rods.source: Areas from the nominal diameters; weight per foot with couplings, taper lengths (an API 76-type taper), grade D minimum tensile strength and service factor for a mildly corrosive well: assumption: typical value, replace with your well file / last dynamometer survey. Steel modulus 30.5e6 psi (textbook value).

pump.source: Pump setting depth and bore from the well file: assumption: typical value, replace with your well file / last dynamometer survey. Tubing anchored, so tubing stretch is neglected.

fluid.source: Produced fluid specific gravity (85 % water cut): assumption: typical value, replace with your well file / last dynamometer survey. Fresh-water gradient 0.433 psi/ft.

operation.source: Pump-off set point of the RPC (stop when the pump card fillage falls below it), expected volumetric efficiency (measured flow / pump displacement at the net stroke: slippage and shrinkage), normal wellhead pressures and pump intake pressure: assumption: typical value, replace with your well file / last dynamometer survey

demo.note: Demo only: the unit strokes at its real speed for the 3D view; faults ramp in over one to two minutes of real time.

groups.Pump: Downhole pump card computed by the RPC

points.label: Unit running (1) or idle on pump-off (0)
Fluid load on the pump card (upstroke minus downstroke load)
Traveling valve check: fluid load lost in 5 s
Liquid rate at the wellhead meter
Motor input power, average while running
Motor peak current on the upstroke
Motor peak current on the downstroke

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

fluid_pound.name: Fluid pound: well pumped off, pump-off control not stopping
fluid_pound.symptoms: fillage low, pump intake pressure near zero, run time 100 %, plunger hits liquid on the downstroke

gas_interference.name: Gas interference: free gas in the pump
gas_interference.symptoms: fillage low although the pump is well submerged, rounded load release on the card

tubing_leak.name: Tubing leak (hole in the tubing)
tubing_leak.symptoms: full pump card, valves hold, but less liquid reaches the surface; tubing pressure falls

worn_pump.name: Worn pump: plunger / barrel wear, leaking traveling valve
worn_pump.symptoms: fluid load leaks off during the traveling valve check, less liquid at the surface

rod_part.name: Rod part (parted rod string)
rod_part.symptoms: loads fall to the weight of the rods above the break, no fluid load, no production, counterweights now drive the gearbox

paraffin_drag.name: Paraffin / rod-tubing friction
paraffin_drag.symptoms: peak load up, minimum load down, card gets taller, gearbox torque and top-rod stress over their limits

counterbalance_shift.name: Counterbalance out of balance (counterweights moved)
counterbalance_shift.symptoms: motor current much higher on one half of the stroke; loads unchanged
